Du verstehst Prozesse schneller als andere und willst Kunden mit einer Lösung überzeugen, die wirklich passt? Dann verbinde bei uns Beratung, Technik und Vertrieb in einer Rolle.

Wer wir sind

docu-fix digitalisiert den sozialwirtschaftlichen Mittelstand. Wir automatisieren Prozesse rund um Dokumente: Scan-Dienstleistungen, Dokumentenmanagement (u. a. DocuWare), Workflows und E-Signatur. Unsere Kunden sind unter anderem Träger der Sozialwirtschaft, Rechenzentren und öffentliche Verkehrsbetriebe.

Unsere Kunden sparen mit uns bis zu 80 % ihrer Prozesskosten – mit einer Lösung, die EU-konform ist. Wir wachsen stark, und unser Vertrieb liefert immer mehr qualifizierte Termine. Damit aus diesen Terminen Projekte werden, suchen wir dich.

Was du machst

  • Du übernimmst die Termine, die unser Inside Sales vereinbart, und führst sie bis zum Abschluss.

  • Du nimmst Prozesse auf. Im Erstgespräch und im Workshop fragst du so lange nach, bis klar ist, wo beim Kunden Zeit und Geld liegen bleiben.

  • Du zeigst die Lösung. In der Demo sieht der Kunde seinen eigenen Rechnungseingang, seine Personalakte oder seinen Vertragsprozess – nicht eine Standardpräsentation.

  • Du entwirfst das Lösungskonzept: welche Bausteine aus Scan, DocuWare, Workflow, Schnittstellen und E-Signatur zusammenpassen und was sie bringen.

  • Du kalkulierst den Aufwand, schreibst das Angebot gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb und vertrittst es vor Geschäftsführung, IT-Leitung und Fachabteilung.

  • Du übergibst gewonnene Projekte sauber dokumentiert an unser Team Technischer Service & Implementierung und bleibst für den Kunden ansprechbar.

  • Du baust Wiederverwendbares auf: Demo-Umgebungen, Lösungsvorlagen und Referenzszenarien für unsere Zielbranchen.

Worauf du dich einstellst

  • Wir verkaufen kein Standardprodukt. Jeder Kunde hat andere Systeme, andere Abläufe und andere Vorgaben – du baust daraus eine Lösung, die trägt.

  • Du sprichst mit Geschäftsführung, IT-Leitung und Buchhaltung. Die eine will Zahlen, die andere Architektur, die dritte einen Alltag, der funktioniert.

  • Du stehst zwischen Vertrieb und Technik. Du versprichst nur, was unser Implementierungsteam liefern kann.

  • Du arbeitest an mehreren Kunden gleichzeitig und hältst Fristen für Angebote und Ausschreibungen.

  • Du bist bei Kunden vor Ort und online unterwegs.

Wen wir suchen

  • Du hast Erfahrung in Presales, Consulting, Business Analyse oder der Einführung von Unternehmenssoftware.

title: Partnerships Associate Manager - GER
description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We are now looking for a Partnerships Associate to support our growth journey in Germany. This is a junior-level role designed for early-career professionals with a strong interest in finance, accounting, or Fintech. You’ll help identify and connect with potential partners, build a strong pipeline, and support the foundation for lasting cosmmercial relationships. Over time, you’ll have the opportunity to develop into a full-cycle Partner Manager role, taking end-to-end ownership of strategic partnerships.

Your responsibilities

Here's a bit more on what you can expect to be doing day-to-day:

  • Partner Identification & Assessment: Research and identify prospective partners aligned with Moss’ strategic priorities and ideal customer profiles. Support the initial assessment of partners through qualitative and quantitative analysis (e.g., partner fit, customer base, integration potential).

  • Outreach & Pipeline Building: Own the top of the funnel for our partnerships pipeline. Proactively reach out to prospective partners via email, LinkedIn, events, and other channels. Engage partners with a clear value proposition and qualify initial interest. First 6 months: ~80% outbound/cold calling to build your own pipeline; shifts toward strategic partner management as you progress.

  • Relationship Building & Support: Assist in building and maintaining strong working relationships with partners. Participate in partner calls and meetings, prepare follow-ups, and support ongoing communication. Help deliver value to partners by understanding their needs and coordinating with internal teams.

  • Process & Reporting: Track outreach and pipeline activity in CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce). Share regular updates on partner funnel status and help improve outreach playbooks and processes. Collaborate with Partnerships, Sales, and Marketing to ensure partner prospects are well aligned with Moss’ commercial strategy.

About you

We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in this role:

  • First experience (1-2 years of full-time work) in business development, partnerships, finance, accounting, or Fintech

  • Academic background in business, finance, economics, or similar fields

  • Fluent in German (C2) & English (C1)

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

  • Self-Starter: You take initiative, manage your own pipeline, and are eager to learn from every interaction.

  • Team Player: You collaborate closely with teammates and internal stakeholders to deliver joint results.

  • Growth-Driven: You’re looking to grow into a Partner Manager role over time and want to learn how to build high-impact commercial partnerships.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

  • Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. 

  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Role

As an Android Software Engineer, you own the Android client experience, how AI feels, behaves, and performs on mobile devices. This is not a thin client role. You will build a production Android application where AI interactions are core to the product, and performance, reliability, and clarity matter.

 

Focus

  • Build and maintain production Android apps using Kotlin.

  • Integrate AI-powered features (chat, vision, voice, recommendations) via backend APIs.

  • Design UX patterns for AI interactions, including streaming responses, retries, and partial results.

  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and responsiveness for AI-heavy flows.

  • Implement analytics, logging, and feedback capture to support AI evaluation and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers on API contracts and system behavior.

  • Ensure app stability, security, and scalability in production environments.

 

Ideal Experiences

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI features (e.g. LLM, vision, speech APIs).

  • Strong understanding of asynchronous programming (Coroutines, Flow).

  • Familiarity with REST or gRPC APIs and structured data formats.

  • Strong debugging and performance profiling skills.

  • Comfort building in environments with latency, partial failure, and non-deterministic behavior.

  • Experience with MLKit or light on-device inference.

  • Published production apps on the Google Play Store.

 

Outcomes

  • Stable, smooth, and reliable real-world use android applications.

  • Performance is optimized: responsive, low-latency, and efficient on memory and CPU.

  • Production issues are detected early, monitored effectively, and resolved with clear root-cause analysis.

 

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin / Java

  • SQL / noSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Mobile developer to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Business Operations Associate
description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

About the Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

 

What You Will Need

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

 

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

Du sorgst für finanzielle Klarheit, Stabilität und Transparenz im Herzen unserer Organisation.

Als Bilanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d) bei der Viessmann Generations Group übernimmst du Verantwortung für die korrekte Buchführung und die Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen in einem vielseitigen Unternehmensumfeld. Du bewertest komplexe Geschäftsvorfälle, begleitest steuerliche Prozesse und unterstützt bei der Erstellung interner Finanzberichte.

In einem schlanken, dynamischen Team bringst du deine Sorgfalt, dein Fachwissen und deine Hands-on-Mentalität ein und trägst damit wesentlich zur finanziellen Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Organisation bei.

Über uns

Viessmann wurde 1917 gegründet und ist seit über einem Jahrhundert ein führendes Industrieunternehmen im Bereich Klimatechnologien. 2024 brachte das Familienunternehmen sein Climate Solutions Geschäft mit Carrier Global zusammen, um eine transatlantische Partnerschaft mit weltweit einzigartiger industrieller Reichweite zu schaffen. Die Viessmann Generations Group verkörpert seitdem die Weiterentwicklung hin zu einem globalen Ökosystem mit dem gemeinsamen Leitbild: Lebensräume für zukünftige Generationen zu gestalten.

Durch strategische Investments, Partnerschaften und philanthropisches Engagement unterstützt die Viessmann Generations Group Unternehmer:innen und Initiativen, die sich den zentralen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit stellen. Die thematischen Investitionsfelder reichen von der Vermeidung, Reduktion und Speicherung von Treibhausgasen über die Verbesserung von Luft- und Wasserqualität und Ernährungssicherheit bis hin zur Förderung von Gesundheit, Bildung, Wissenschaft und dem Schutz demokratischer Werten.

Der Viessmann Way beschreibt, wie wir arbeiten, führen und gemeinsam Wert schaffen – ob als Teammitglied, Unternehmer oder Partner in unserem Ökosystem. Der Viessmann Way ist kein Regelwerk, sondern ein Kompass: ein lebendiges Set an Prinzipien, geformt durch unternehmerisches Handeln und ausgerichtet auf unser langfristiges Leitbild.


Deine Chance

Diese Position bietet dir die Möglichkeit, deine Buchhaltungs- und Abschlussexpertise in ein werteorientiertes Umfeld einzubringen.

Als Bilanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d) bei der Viessmann Generations Group übernimmst du Verantwortung für die sachgerechte Abbildung von Geschäftsvorfällen, die Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen und die Mitwirkung an internen Berichtsprozessen. Du arbeitest eng mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen, bringst dein Fachwissen in steuerliche und treasury-bezogene Themen ein und sorgst für finanzielle Klarheit und Stabilität.

Bilanzierung & Jahresabschlüsse

  • Du erstellst Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB für mehrere Gesellschaften.

title: Mechanical Design Engineering Team Lead
description:
About pplwise

pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics

Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will lead the mechanical design of the robots as they move from prototype to series production.

About the role

This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics builds its own robot hardware in-house: mechanics, electronics and software. Orders are growing, and the robots are moving from prototypes to series production. Designs that worked in the lab now need to be built reliably, at scale and at the right cost. The hardest problems often sit between disciplines: parts that work on their own can fail once they're assembled with the electronics.

The mechanical team has four engineers, most of them at the start of their careers, and they need someone who guides them every day. You'll be the technical lead for the mechanical side of the product and the counterpart to the electronics lead, so the current mechanical manager can focus on core R&D. Your time splits roughly evenly between hands-on engineering and technical leadership. You'll work closely with Electronics, Production, Procurement and the CTO, and you'll set the engineering habits while the team is still small.

What you'll do

  • Mentor the mechanical engineers day to day: help them make design decisions, set methods and keep projects focused

  • Design parts and assemblies in CAD, including tolerancing, and check every design for manufacturability and cost before it goes out

  • Lead testing and integration of mechanics and electronics, and solve the problems that only show once everything is assembled

  • Prioritise incoming work, follow up on progress and make the day-to-day technical calls on the mechanical side

  • Make the gated design process work in practice and run design reviews (safety, mechanics, electronics, manufacturability) before parts are integrated

  • Put design for manufacturing and design for cost in place: fewer, standardised parts and production methods that scale

  • Work with the electronics owner of each robot module from the first prototype on, and with Production on manufacturability and production jigs

  • Build and iterate prototypes based on customer and field feedback

About you

  • Several years of hands-on mechanical design in R&D at a company that develops and builds its own electromechanical products (e.g. power tools, home appliances, e-mobility, production machines, robotics, marine propulsion)

  • A proven record of taking an electromechanical product from prototype to series production (ideally 1,000+ units a year) on a fast development cycle of about a year, not a decade-long program

  • You still design hands-on in CAD, mainly metal parts and assemblies, with strong tolerancing skills (any CAD tool; Onshape is a plus)

  • You've applied design for manufacturing and design for cost, and cut cost through design: fewer parts, standard parts

  • At least two years of mentoring or technically guiding other engineers; a team-lead title isn't required

  • Experience testing and integrating mechanics with electronics

  • You've introduced processes, design reviews or engineering standards that helped a team deliver

  • You handle unclear requirements and break complex problems down so others can work on them

  • German is a plus, since production is mostly German-speaking

  • Bonus: GD&T and tolerance stack-ups, design of production jigs, or projects with motors, motor controllers or electronics

What Filics offers

  • A key role at an early stage: shape both the mechanical team and the product

  • Real ownership of the mechanical side, from first prototype to series production

  • A mix of hands-on engineering and leadership, with a path into team lead and engineering management as Filics grows

  • Fast design cycles driven by customer and field feedback

  • A small, high-caliber team with close collaboration across mechanics, electronics, software and production

  • Fast growth: one year at Filics teaches you what usually takes many years at a large company

  • An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly

Sound like you? Apply with your CV.

title: Founding Account Executive
description:
About BoWatt

BoWatt is building AI agents for requirements and systems engineering in manufacturing. We help the teams engineering cars, planes, rockets, factories, chips, and medical devices tackle complex engineering work with software.

We bootstrapped to €500k+ ARR before raising our first round. Our investors include Atlantic Foodlabs, Buildery (CDTM affiliates), and Prequel Ventures, alongside angels from Cohere and Luminovo.

Now we’re looking for an ambitious Account Executive to turn customer interest into closed deals.

The role

You want to become exceptional at selling. You’re early in your sales career, but you’ve already shown that you learn fast, create opportunities, and take ownership of results.

At BoWatt, you’ll own your pipeline from first conversation to signed customer. You’ll sell a technical product to manufacturing companies across DACH, learn directly from our CEO, and help turn what works into a repeatable sales process.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role, not a sales-management position. You don’t need to have built a sales team. You do need the drive and judgement to move deals forward without waiting for a finished playbook.

What you’ll do

  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound, alongside leads generated with BDR support.

  • Run discovery with engineering and business stakeholders to understand their workflows, pain points, and buying process.

  • Deliver tailored product demos and build a clear business case for BoWatt.

  • Own opportunities through qualification, pilot discussions, negotiation, and close.

  • Keep your CRM and forecasts accurate, with clear next steps for every opportunity.

  • Bring customer feedback to the product team and help improve our messaging, demos, and sales process.

What you bring

  • Early experience in B2B software or technical sales. You may already be closing deals as an AE, or be a standout SDR/BDR ready to take on the full sales cycle.

  • Evidence that you perform: targets exceeded, pipeline you created, deals you helped win, rapid progression, or a business you built yourself. We care more about what you’ve done than your title or years of experience.

  • The curiosity to understand a technical product and explain its value clearly. Manufacturing experience helps, but isn’t required.

  • Strong communication: you ask good questions, listen carefully, and make the next step clear.

  • Resilience and initiative. You follow up, handle rejection, and find ways to make progress.

  • Fluent German and professional English, our internal working language.

  • Willingness to work from our Munich office four days per week.

What we offer

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission.

  • Meaningful equity

  • Close collaboration with the CEO and hands-on onboarding into our product, customers, and industry.

  • Ownership of real customer relationships and room to take on larger deals and greater responsibility as you develop.

  • A small team of experienced startup builders and former founders.

  • 25 vacation days plus public holidays, company retreats, and WellPass membership.

Interview process

  1. 20-minute introductory call.

  2. 90-minute sales interview with the CEO and a team member.

  3. 60-minute culture and team interview.

  4. References and offer.


We aim to complete the process within 14 days.

What We Can Offer 

This position combines hands-on EDI development with responsibility for integrations that support our supply chain. You will apply your business process knowledge to practical technical solutions and contribute to global ERP initiatives and local EDI rollouts.

If you bring strong EDI expertise and experience with O2C and S2P processes, we can support your onboarding into the Infor M3 integration stack. You will build on your existing knowledge while becoming familiar with our applications, mapping tools and integration environment.

You will join a supportive, international IT team, working alongside colleagues and specialist providers with opportunities to deepen your expertise in integration delivery and EDI operations.

How You Will Spend Your Time as Our Next Integration Specialist – EDI 

You will connect business requirements with the technical delivery and operation of EDI integrations. Your work will span document mapping, integration configuration, rollout support and daily troubleshooting, helping ensure that transactions are processed reliably across our Infor applications and external EDI networks.

What You Will Do 

  • Translate business requirements and trading partner specifications into practical EDI solutions, supporting document flows across Order to Cash, Logistics and Source to Pay.

  • Create and maintain complex document mappings, transforming partner messages into standard XML formats and vice versa.

  • Develop, configure and maintain EDI integrations across Infor M3, Infor ION, Infor OS and Infor Enterprise Collaborator (IEC/MEC).

  • Define and maintain mapping standards, data validation rules and interface specifications, supported by clear functional and technical documentation.

  • Support EDI workstreams within global ERP initiatives and local rollouts across business units, maintaining consistency with global integration templates.

  • Monitor daily EDI transactions, prioritise critical issues and resolve integration or transmission failures to help prevent supply chain disruptions.

  • Analyse performance across EDI networks and clearing centres, identify recurring errors and bottlenecks, and coordinate configuration adjustments and testing with external providers.

  • Maintain standard messages and application interfaces in line with relevant industry standards and data compliance requirements.

  • Collaborate with internal IT teams, business stakeholders and external providers to deliver and support integrations involving both Infor and other applications.

What We Expect of You 

Essential Skills & Experience 

  • Strong familiarity with the document sequences supporting core supply chain processes such as Order to Cash (O2C) , Logistics and Source to Pay (S2P), including orders, invoices and shipping notices.

  • Extensive hands-on experience in Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), B2B integration frameworks and complex data mapping environments.

  • Strong technical proficiency in EDI mapping tools, XML schemas and data transformation languages.

  • Good awareness of global B2B messaging standards, such as EDIFACT, and electronic communication protocols.

  • Proven ability to read and analyse Java code in Eclipse IDE to debug custom mapping extensions and data routing rules.

  • Strong communication and technical documentation skills, with the ability to translate business and trading partner requirements into clear mapping and interface specifications.

  • Ability to work effectively in a complex, collaborative matrix environment with virtual teams in a multi-cultural and geographically diverse setting.

  • Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, including root-cause analysis of data payload errors and transmission failures, with sound judgement in challenging situations.

  • A strong command of spoken and written English is required, and knowledge of German is considered a plus.

Valuable Experience 

  • Practical knowledge of Infor Enterprise Collaborator (IEC/MEC), Infor ION Framework and Infor OS, including their integration with Infor M3 and the routing of EDI documents into core applications.

  • Familiarity with Mapping Manager and Business Document Mapper within the Infor integration environment.

  • Onboarding customers, suppliers and 3 PLs via EDI.

Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Germany. Please note that visa or work-permit sponsorship is not available for this position.

title: Product Manager MISSION AIRCRAFT (m/f/d)
description:
About the role:

As Product Manager Mission Aircraft, you will own the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle of our military multi-mission aircraft. The aircraft is designed as an optionally piloted platform combining manned and unmanned operations with modular mission capabilities for applications such as Counter-UxS, ISR, maritime and border patrol, training and manned-unmanned teaming.

You will work at the intersection of customer needs, operational requirements, engineering feasibility and commercial viability. In close collaboration with Engineering, Operations, Sales, Product Marketing and other stakeholders, you will translate complex mission needs into clear product priorities and an executable roadmap. This end-to-end ownership, from customer discovery and product strategy through delivery and lifecycle development, is consistent with Quantum Systems' current Product Management model

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Mission Aircraft, translating market, customer and operational requirements into clear product priorities and measurable outcomes.

  • Drive customer and market discovery by engaging with end users, governmental customers, Sales and Solutions teams to understand operational challenges, mission scenarios and capability gaps.

  • Shape the multi-mission capability roadmap across relevant applications such as Counter-UxS, ISR, maritime and border patrol, training and manned-unmanned teaming.

  • Drive payload and mission-system integration such as radar, EO/IR, SIGINT, communications and other mission-specific payloads.

    Lead product trade-off decisions across performance, payload, endurance, platform constraints, cost, risk, certification and time-to-market.

  • Own product readiness and lifecycle decisions, defining acceptance criteria and supporting validation, release readiness, market introduction and continuous product improvement.

  • Create cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Operations, Programs, Sales, Product Marketing and external technology partners, clearly communicating priorities, dependencies, risks and roadmap decisions.




What you bring to the team:

  • You have completed a degree/apprenticeship in the field of ...

  • You already have at least X years of professional/practical experience in ...

  • You are privately interested in ...

  • Due to your open, communicative, friendly and competent attitude, it is easy for you to be considered as an internal expert.

  • You are highly self-motivated and drive your area of responsibility independently.

  • Communication in English is a matter of course for you.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • You have a degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a comparable technical field.

  • You have several years of experience in technical Product Management, Systems Engineering or product development within aerospace, defence, UAS, aviation or another complex hardware-software environment.

  • You have experience taking technically complex products or capabilities from customer need and concept through development, validation and market or operational deployment.

  • You have a strong technical understanding and are comfortable working across aircraft systems, hardware, software, sensors, communications and mission-system integration.

  • You have strong commercial judgement and can balance customer value, operational utility, technical feasibility, cost, schedule and product scalability.

  • Ideally, you have experience with military aviation, UAS, ISR, Counter-UAS, mission systems, payload integration or manned-unmanned teaming.

  • You are comfortable making decisions in a fast-moving environment with incomplete information and can bring structure and clarity to complex stakeholder discussions.

  • Communicating in English comes naturally to you; German is a plus. Similar current Quantum Systems Product Manager roles require fluent English and treat German as advantageous.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

So minimierst Du Risiken und ermöglichst den verantwortungsvollen Einsatz moderner Technologien.

Schwerpunkte deiner Rolle

  • Pflege von Verarbeitungsverzeichnis, TOM-Dokumentation, Löschkonzepten, Datenschutzhinweisen und Einwilligungsprozessen

  • Steuerung technischer und organisatorischer Sicherheitsmaßnahmen mit IT-Abteilung und UK-Sicherheitsteam, inkl. Notfallvorsorge und Incident Response

  • Landing Page & Funnel Optimisation: Analyse landing page performance and customer journeys, working closely with our CRO team to identify conversion barriers and improve content, messaging and conversion elements.

Analytics, Reporting & Collaboration

  • Performance Analytics: Monitor key performance indicators, identify trends and translate campaign data into clear recommendations for further optimisation.

  • Reporting & Dashboards: Build and maintain meaningful dashboards and reporting structures using tools such as Looker Studio and Excel.

  • Partner Collaboration: Coordinate with external marketing partners, align on campaign performance and ensure transparent reporting and continuous improvement.

 

What You Bring:

  • Education & Analytical Foundation: Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, developed through education and/or professional experience.

Deep Google Ads expertise, with a proven ability to independently manage, optimise and scale campaigns end-to-end. Experience in nutrition, food or supplements is a strong plus.

  • Analytical Mindset & Reporting: You confidently analyse performance data, translate insights into actionable improvements and build meaningful reports and dashboards using Excel, Looker Studio or comparable tools.

  • Conversion Focus: You understand the relationship between advertising, landing pages and conversion rates. Experience with CRO, A/B testing or landing page optimisation is a strong plus.

  • Ownership & Initiative: You work independently, proactively identify opportunities and take ownership of measurable results.

  • Language Skills: Excellent German (C1 level) and strong English communication skills.

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

description:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now.

Your work will contribute to turning advanced robotics into reliable, manufacturable and deployable technology for real-world industrial applications.

Don't see the right role?

Great people don't always fit neatly into an existing job description. If you're excited about what we're building but haven't found a suitable opening, we'd still love to hear from you!

We're always interested in meeting people who want to help shape the future of robotics and Physical AI, whether your expertise lies in:

  • Engineering & Robotics: Mechanical engineering, electronics, actuators, embedded systems, controls, robotics and system integration.

  • Software & AI: Robotics software, machine learning, perception, motion planning and software development.

  • Product & Industrialisation: Product development, testing, manufacturing, quality, reliability and technical operations.

  • Business & Commercial: Business development, sales, marketing, partnerships and customer success.

  • Operations & Corporate Functions: Supply chain, finance, people, administration and other areas that help a growing company succeed.

If you bring a different skill set that you believe could make a difference at TACTILIA, we want to hear from you.

What happens next?

Tell us a little about yourself, your experience and what you'd like to contribute to TACTILIA. Share your CV and, if available, your LinkedIn profile. Our team will review your application and get in touch if we see a potential match with our current or future opportunities. If there isn't an immediate fit, we'd be happy to stay connected for relevant opportunities down the road, subject to your consent.

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are looking for our first dedicated Senior Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs and payment flows. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows.

  • Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction.

  • Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners.

  • Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting).

  • Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively.

  • Own vulnerability management end to end: a risk-ranked backlog, remediation SLAs, an escalation path, and closing findings together with the teams.

  • Scope and coordinate the annual external penetration test and produce secure-development evidence for PCI-DSS and ISO 27001.


Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.


Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years in Product/Application Security (or 3+ years and a strong software engineering/web-pentesting background), with a track record of true ownership.

  • You read and write production code (Python, Go, TypeScript, Ruby, etc.) and deeply understand web frameworks, CI/CD, and Kubernetes.

  • You have deep knowledge of web and API security, specifically authentication/authorization models (OAuth2, JWT), rate limiting, tenant isolation, IDOR, and XSS.

  • You have strong cloud security fundamentals (GCP preferred), specifically regarding public exposure, secrets hygiene, and WAF rules.

  • You have run threat modelling and secure design reviews on real systems (STRIDE or similar).

  • Hands-on with SAST/SCA/secrets scanning in CI (Aikido, Semgrep, Snyk or similar).

  • You prioritize by real-world risk, propose trade-offs rather than demanding perfection, and communicate complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • Bonus Points: You have experience securing high-volume, multi-tenant B2B APIs and utilizing AI tooling to accelerate triage and review.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure.

  • You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

  • We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe.

  • You will get a competitive salary.

What You’ll Do

You will be the single technical authority between our GPU-as-a-service business and the colocation providers that host our NVIDIA clusters. You turn cluster architecture and OEM requirements into a precise, contractable statement of work (SOW) for the data centre white space, then hold the provider to it through design, installation and acceptance.

We are growing from tens of megawatts to hundreds, on rack-scale liquid-cooled platforms at 130 kW per rack and rising to 200 kW and beyond. Mistakes in power, cooling or fibre specification show up as stranded capacity, delayed cluster delivery and disputes, so the role carries real commercial weight.

Key Responsibilities

Technical negotiation with colocation providers

  • Lead technical due diligence on candidate sites: power availability and energisation dates, redundancy topology, liquid-cooling capability, floor loading, rack logistics, fibre and meet-me access.

Specification & SOW

  • Define clear scope boundaries and responsibilities between us, the colocation provider, OEMs and installation contractors, with no gaps and no overlaps.

  • Maintain a requirements baseline with traceability from OEM document, to SOW clause, to acceptance test.

Design, installation & acceptance

  • Review provider and contractor designs, shop drawings and method statements against the SOW; run design reviews and close findings.

  • Define acceptance: factory and site tests, liquid flush and cleanliness, power quality, thermal performance at full load, fibre loss, burn-in, and the evidence pack needed for each gate.

  • Attend key witness tests and sign off, or reject, completion of each phase before hardware is energised.

  • Manage technical change requests and variations, and advise on cost and schedule impact.

Knowledge & standards

  • Build reusable reference designs, SOW templates and a site-scoring framework so each new deployment starts from a proven baseline.

  • Track the roadmap: higher rack densities, 800 VDC distribution, new cooling classes and optics, and tell the business early what it means for sites already contracted.

Deliverables You Own:

  • Technical schedules to the colocation agreement: Measurable commitments, tested in acceptance, with remedies agreed by legal.

  • Cluster white-space SOW: Complete enough that a contractor can price and build without asking us questions; traceable to OEM requirements.

  • Reference designs and layouts: Rack, row and POD layouts, power and cooling single-line and P&ID level interfaces, fibre pathways and densities.

  • Acceptance test plan and evidence pack: Pass and fail criteria set before work starts; signed results per gate.

  • Requirements baseline and change log: One current version of the truth, with every variation recorded and costed.

  • Risk and issues register: Technical risks to schedule and capacity, with owners and dates.

Working Relationships:

  • OEMs, mainly NVIDIA: You are the facility-side counterpart; you obtain, interpret and challenge site-requirement documents.

  • Colocation providers: Day-to-day technical counterpart through negotiation, build and acceptance.

  • Direct experience writing or reviewing technical specifications and SOWs for white-space fitout, and managing contractors against them to acceptance.

  • Strong working knowledge of data centre power: MV and LV distribution, UPS and generator topologies, redundancy models (N+1, 2N, distributed), busway and rack power, metering and power quality.

  • Strong working knowledge of cooling: direct-to-chip liquid cooling, CDUs, facility and technology loops, warm-water and dry-cooler designs, fluid quality and flushing, leak detection and containment.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Who we are

At GetGround, our mission is to make property investment safer, faster and more accessible for everyone.

We’ve built an all-in-one property investment platform that supports investors from opportunity analysis and company formation through to financing, accounting and portfolio management. By bringing software, data and specialist services into one experience, we make property investing simpler, clearer and more cost-effective.

More than 30,000 investors across 70 countries trust us with their identity documents, company records, bank details and the financial picture of their portfolios. Several of our products are regulated by the FCA, and we’re now serving institutional clients and expanding into new markets.

Our security needs to grow faster than we do. We’re looking for someone to own it.

The opportunity

You’ll be GetGround’s first dedicated security engineer. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. You’ll decide how we prevent, detect and respond to threats across our cloud, devices, identity and SaaS estate, and then build it.

The scope goes beyond configuring tools. You’ll run our SIEM and own our alerts, keep us ahead of a threat landscape that AI is changing fast, and make sure leadership knows where we stand and what we need.

You’ll work closely with our site reliability engineer, product engineers, our Compliance team and our Data Protection Officer. Over time, you’ll be able to shape how security works across GetGround, including the standards, processes and future hires we need.

What you’ll do

  • Own our security posture. You’ll be the person accountable for security at GetGround. Assess where we are today and define a roadmap that balances security with what the business needs. Be pragmatic: understand our stage, what risk we can accept for now and what has to be fixed today. Keep leadership informed about our risks, what you need and how we’ll address them.

  • Stay ahead of threats. The threat landscape is moving faster than ever, and AI is driving much of that change. AI-generated phishing, deepfake social engineering, prompt injection and data leaking through AI tools are all part of it. Track what’s emerging, judge what matters to a regulated fintech and act before it reaches us.

  • Run our SIEM and own our alerts. Make sure logs from GCP, identity, endpoints, SaaS tools and our own platform reach the SIEM and stay there. Write detection rules, map coverage against MITRE ATT&CK, tune out the noise and make sure nothing important goes unnoticed.

  • Automate response. Build playbooks that contain common threats as soon as an alert fires. Lead incident response when things go wrong, and make sure we learn from it.

  • Protect the data we hold. Know where sensitive data lives, who can access it and when it moves. Secure every channel it passes through: devices through endpoint detection and response (EDR) and anti-malware monitoring and protection, email and cloud storage through data loss prevention, and our platform and tools through access controls. Make the secure path the easy path for everyone at GetGround.

  • Work across the business. Partner with our site reliability engineer and product engineers on secure infrastructure and design, and with Compliance on our obligations. Assess vendors and run training people actually remember.

  • Set our policies and back them with working controls. Build and keep updating our security policies, best practices and information security management system (ISMS). Implement and automate the technical controls behind our security certifications and frameworks, such as ISO 27001, so that passing an audit reflects how we really operate.

What you bring

  • Hands-on detection and response experience. You’ve run a SIEM, built detection rules and owned alerting in production. You know what a bad log looks like.

  • A habit of staying current. You follow how attackers are using AI and other new techniques. You turn what you learn into concrete defences, not headlines.

  • Cloud security depth. You understand cloud infrastructure, identity and networking well enough to harden them, ideally on GCP.

  • Endpoint and identity experience. You’ve run EDR, anti-malware and identity tooling across a company’s devices and SaaS estate.

  • An automation-first mindset. You’d rather automate a control or a response than do it by hand, and you use AI tools to multiply your output.

  • Judgement about risk. You can separate a real threat from a theoretical one, prioritise accordingly and explain the trade-off to people who aren’t specialists.

  • Ownership and clear communication. You take responsibility for outcomes, surface problems early and tell leadership plainly what you need. You can explain a security risk to an engineer, an auditor or the CEO.

Bonus

  • Experience in fintech, financial services or another FCA-regulated environment.

  • Experience implementing controls for security certifications such as ISO 27001.

  • Experience with SOAR tooling and infrastructure as code, such as Terraform.

  • Experience securing AI systems or LLM-based products.

  • Experience as the first or only security hire at a startup or scale-up.

  • Experience with UK GDPR or working alongside a Data Protection Officer.

  • Experience with identity and zero-trust controls, such as SSO, phishing-resistant MFA and conditional access.

  • Experience running penetration tests, red-team exercises or a bug bounty programme.

This role isn’t for you if

  • You want to stay in one specialism. In the same week you might write a detection rule, roll out a device policy and close a gap in our compliance controls.

  • You’re comfortable with alerts nobody reads. We want fewer, better alerts, and someone who cares whether they lead to action.

  • You see security as the department of no. We need someone who finds the secure way to ship, not someone who blocks the business by default.

  • You want a fully defined programme to execute. We need someone who can assess what exists, set the direction and take ownership of it.

  • You don’t connect with how we work. Our values—No BS, pursuit of excellence, feedback obsessed and healthy ego—mean communicating directly, holding a high bar, seeking feedback and being willing to change your mind.

Why join

  • Own security for a platform trusted with sensitive financial data by more than 30,000 investors.

  • Build our security function from the ground up as we expand internationally.

  • Work on challenging problems across cloud infrastructure, customer data, AI and regulated services.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity.

  • Hybrid London working, with three days per week in Waterloo.

  • Benefits include private health and dental cover, a learning budget, a home-office setup budget and 12 mental health days per year.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. title: Lab Technician
description:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.


We’re looking for a detail-oriented Lab Technician to keep our Bristol labs running safely and reliably. You’ll support hardware engineers with testing, setup and equipment upkeep in a fast-paced AI hardware company.


Key responsibilities

  • Run routine tests and measurements across both Bristol labs, following established procedures

  • Set up, maintain, calibrate and troubleshoot lab equipment

  • Carry out basic soldering and small rework tasks as needed

  • Record results accurately and keep clear, traceable logs

  • Uphold health and safety procedures, including housekeeping, equipment safety checks and proactively reporting risks

  • Support audits, risk assessments and safe working practices, including for lone working

  • Help improve lab processes and SOPs

  • Keep both labs organised and stocked, and hand over clearly on the days you’re not in

Requirements

  • Experience in an electronics, hardware or lab environment

  • Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to documentation

  • Solid understanding of workplace health and safety, with a proactive approach to it

  • Able to work independently and as part of a team across two labs

  • Right to work in the UK

title: AMI Scientist - Geometry and 3D Vision
description:
About AMI

We are building a new breed of AI systems that (1) understand the real world, (2) have persistent memory, (3) can reason and plan, and (4) are controllable and safe.

We are a team of scientists and engineers building frontier world model-based AI. We combine the scientific rigor of a top-tier research institute with focus on engineering excellence and execution.

We are a global company, with offices in Paris, Montreal, New York, and Singapore. Come build the future of AI with us!

About this Role

AMI believes AI agents should predict and plan using an internal model of the world — their world model. We’re looking for new team members to advance the state-of-the-art in world modeling. We believe that video is a rich and abundant source of data reflecting how the world works, and that in general models need to be able to process continuous, high-dimensional data from a variety of sensors to: (a) understand context about the current state of the physical world, (b) make predictions about how the world will evolve, possibly as a result of actions taken, and (c) plan and adapt sequences of actions to complete complex tasks, possibly in dynamic, complex environments.

 

You will work with a team on world model research efforts, with a specific focus on 3D geometry of the real world, including::

  • Self-supervised learning methods to efficiently learn from video and other continuous, high-dimensional signals

  • New architectures that efficiently learn to predict world dynamics from video and other high-dimensional signals

  • Scalable algorithms for pre-processing and curating video data

  • Evaluations for benchmarking world model understanding, prediction, and planning

  • Efficient algorithms for model-based planning and reasoning

 

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or a related field

  • Proficiency in Python

  • Ability to design, run, and analyze experiments independently

  • Understanding of machine learning fundamentals, large-scale training, and accelerator-based (GPU or TPU) compute environments

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Deep expertise in at least one of the following: 3D/4D reconstruction, SLAM or SfM, depth and pose estimation, point tracking.

  • Demonstrated record of contributing to advanced research projects via publications and/or major model releases

  • Experience developing evaluation frameworks for world models

  • Experience releasing and maintaining open-source projects

  • Proficiency in a deep learning framework (PyTorch or JAX)

description:
- About Quandela:

Quandela is a European deeptech scale-up developing modular, scalable and energy-efficient photonic and spin-optical quantum computers, accessible through the cloud and on-premises.

With over 140 employees, we develop our own hardware and software stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to quantum control systems and algorithms.

Our ambition is to build large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computers, combining quantum dot technologies, scalable spin-photon interfaces and distributed entanglement within future Spin-Optical Quantum Computing (SPOQC) architectures.

You will join Quandela's Semiconductor Optics Team, bringing together expertise in quantum optics, spin physics, semiconductor technologies and quantum information.

Your focus will be to develop and validate photon-mediated spin-spin entanglement protocols, improve spin coherence and operation fidelity, and advance optical control techniques for future hybrid quantum computing architectures.

We are looking for an experienced experimental scientist who can independently drive complex experimental activities, shape technical directions and translate scientific results into reliable technological building blocks, working closely with our research and engineering teams.

With several experimental building blocks still under development, you'll have room to shape technical choices, tackle open scientific challenges and directly influence our technology roadmap.

Requirements

We are looking for an experienced experimental researcher combining strong scientific expertise, technical autonomy and the ability to drive complex research activities.

  • PhD in Spin Physics, Quantum Optics or a related field.

title: GPU Engineer
description:
About Kog

At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents.

Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act.

Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs.

We've developed several technologies to make this possible:

  • Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs.

  • KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency.

  • Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading.

  • Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach.

Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution.

Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released.

Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today.

These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results.

We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually.

This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it.

Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai.

What you'll work on

You'll join our GPU engineering team to tackle challenging performance problems and help build the internal agents that will accelerate this work.

  • Develop and optimize GPU kernels using C++, CUDA, HIP, and low-level instructions.

  • Investigate GPU architecture, memory access, synchronization, and execution bottlenecks.

  • Profile and benchmark workloads to identify and validate performance improvements.

  • Optimize inference operations and communication across multiple GPUs.

  • Implement and optimize new AI models on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.

  • Help build AI agents for GPU engineering, enabling automated code optimization, correctness testing, benchmarking, and iterative improvements.

  • Take ownership of technical decisions and their implementation.

What we're looking for

We're looking for an experienced GPU Engineer who can contribute quickly and independently to complex performance problems.

  • Strong hands-on experience developing and optimizing GPU kernels, ideally using CUDA C++ or HIP/ROCm.

  • Deep understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchy, parallel execution, and performance bottlenecks.

  • Strong C++ skills and experience profiling and benchmarking GPU workloads.

  • Proven ownership of challenging technical projects, from implementation to measured results.

  • Interest in developing AI agents and tools to accelerate GPU engineering.

Experience with PTX, CDNA ISA, multi-GPU systems, low-latency inference, or GPU performance portability is particularly valuable.

A PhD in HPC, computer science, or a related field is a plus when backed by substantial engineering work. Previous experience building AI agents is not required.

Location and availability

Candidates must already be based in Paris or elsewhere in Île-de-France.

We are not considering relocation from other regions or countries for this position.

We're looking for someone who can join the team quickly.

description:
About Sonio

Each year, 140M children are born. Birth defects affect 1 in 33 births in developed countries, and in 50% of cases, they are not detected during prenatal examinations. Prenatal medicine is particularly complex, and the scans impose heavy responsibilities on healthcare professionals. They can also be a source of stress for future parents.

Resulting from 5 years of collaboration between world-renowned experts from Necker Hospital and Ecole Polytechnique, Sonio uses artificial intelligence to improve prenatal screening and diagnosis. Based on patented algorithms and a proprietary expert database, Sonio aims to become the reference tool to help practitioners improve screening, reduce diagnostic errors, and optimize pregnant women’s medical path.

Sonio's mission is to improve women's and children's health by promoting access and quality of care through technological innovation, medical expertise, and collective intelligence.

About the role


We are looking for a DevOps / Platform Engineering intern to join our Platform team (DevOps, Data and Staff Engineers), which runs the infrastructure behind our SaaS platform. As the platform grows, so do our internal operational requests. Your mission will be to find out how far AI agents can take this RUN work off our plate, without giving up control.


Your main mission will be to:

  • Build an AI agent that turns internal infrastructure requests (provisioning a new service, managing AWS resources and access, environment variables or app configuration, Kubernetes or ArgoCD resources) into ready-to-review GitHub Pull Requests:

    1. Understand. The agent parses the request and picks the matching runbook.

    2. Generate. It produces the Terraform, Kubernetes or ArgoCD changes in our IaC repositories.

    3. Validate. It runs automated checks: tests, linting, and security and misconfiguration scans.

    4. Propose. It opens a traceable Pull Request for human review and approval.

  • Design the guardrails that make this safe: least-privilege access, approval steps, and predictable, repeatable runs. The AI never changes production on its own, and engineers stay in control of every change,

  • Deliver a working proof of concept on real internal requests, built so it can grow into a production-ready tool.

The AI never changes production on its own. Engineers stay in control, and every change is reviewed, tested and traceable.


Our infrastructure stack

  • Cloud: AWS, multi-region

  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform

  • Containers & GitOps: Kubernetes on EKS, Helm, ArgoCD

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

  • Observability: Datadog

  • Security & Compliance: vulnerability and misconfiguration scanning, least-privilege IAM, and a HITRUST/SOC2-driven change process

  • Backend: Elixir/Phoenix

About the profile


Sonio is a mission-driven company so interest in our mission is critical. Other requirements are:

  • Currently in Master 2 / Bac+5 of Engineering School or University, you are majoring in Computer Science and are looking for an internship lasting between 5 and 6 months,

  • Good knowledge of AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Git and CI/CD workflows,

  • Solid scripting skills (Python or similar) and a security-minded approach to infrastructure changes,

  • Strong interest in AI agents and LLMs applied to real engineering problems,

  • Experience with ArgoCD, Helm or Datadog is a plus,

  • You speak English and ideally French.

Deploying an industrial robot still takes months of integration and programming, and the moment a part, a process, or a position changes, it starts over. Inbolt makes it take minutes.

Our generalist vision model gives robots the ability to see, think, and adapt in real time, so any robot can master any process, part, or station. Working alongside our Product Lead, you will make sure that what we build answers real business needs: you will gather what customers and the field are telling us, translate it into clear product priorities and specs, and give Sales and Ops the material they need to sell and deploy Inbolt with confidence.
